Q: ALE does not line wrap linter messages A:

That is how "virtual text" is displayed by default when the option 'text_wrap': 'truncate' is passed to :help prop_add() or when it is omitted. There is no global way to alter that behavior.

From here, you can…

  • Read the plugin's documentation to see if it puts that behavior behind a plugin-level option (like g:ale_truncate_virtualtext or whatever).

  • If there is no plugin-level option, ask the maintainer to add one or to change the default behavior.

  • Better yet, do the change yourself and open a pull request in the plugin's repository.

Q: How to export CSV output with quote encapsulation in SQL Server Management Studio? A:

There's an option for this, in Tools -> Options -> Query Results -> SQL Server -> Results to Grid

In SSMS 16+ (AKA SSMS Build 13+), it's part of another option called "Include column headers when copying or saving the results".

In SSMS 2014 and older, it's a separate option called "Quote strings containing list separators when saving .csv results".

In all versions, you may need to open a new query window to see the change take effect; running a query in an existing window may not reflect the settings change.

Q: selecting a particular subseries of strings from a string A:

One more alternative approach, this works by finding the character position of the last "\\":

substr(temp_file,gregexpr("\\\\",temp_file)[[1]][length(gregexpr("\\\\",temp_file)[[1]])]+1,nchar(temp_file))
